verdict.rationale: The only documented multi-item operation is the Local Search POI and descriptions endpoints, whose `ids` parameter accepts up to 20 location IDs in a single request. The Answers service also mentions grounding on multiple searches, but that is not a user-driven bulk operation. Missing for 10: a general batch endpoint for submitting many web/news/image queries in one call, bulk limits beyond 20 POI IDs, async or bulk job handling, and independent corroboration of bulk usage.
